title: System design
summary: Design a real service on the sheet while two engineers probe your choices.

phases.title: Intro
phases.goal: Introduce self and format in under 20 seconds.

phases.title: Requirements
phases.goal: Let candidate scope; answer with numbers; push for non-functional reqs.

phases.title: API
phases.goal: Ask for main calls and core entities.

phases.title: Design
phases.goal: Candidate draws; ask for an end-to-end request walk-through.

phases.title: Deep dive
phases.goal: Senior+: candidate picks; else interviewer picks. One failure mode, one trade-off.
